purpose: Suggestions review board. Every improvement suggestion lists the options (A/B/C), a recommended path, cost and risk. Nothing here is implemented before the owner chooses a path. review_status = pending means a reviewer must decide first.

rows.title: Unblock G7 with an executable price
rows.description: G7 (executable price) is blocked because the NFL publishes no odds. Without a price, ROI/CLV cannot be graded and no strategy can qualify.
rows.option_a: Buy/license an official odds feed and store opening+closing snapshots per market.
rows.option_b: Use third-party archive lines, explicitly labeled third-party, never presented as official.
rows.option_c: Keep market cells blank and flagged; leaderboard stays a rejection machine until a price exists.
rows.recommended_path: C — no price is invented anywhere on this site; revisit when the owner funds a feed.
rows.risk: A: licensing and data-rights review needed; B: third-party data cannot be verified as official; C: no strategy can ever qualify under current rules

rows.title: Timestamped injury snapshots Wed/Thu/Fri
rows.description: The brief requires the injury report as a timestamped series (Wednesday to kickoff) with retained hashes, so practice designations can be replayed as known. Today only one capture exists.
rows.option_a: Automate daily captures Wed-Fri with raw HTML hashes, fetch timestamps and conflict flags.
rows.option_b: Capture once per week only (status quo).
rows.option_c: Do not capture; rely on the single live page.
rows.recommended_path: A — required for Q03/Q15 and for any backtest that replays pre-kickoff knowledge.
rows.risk: source/schema changes need a drift alarm; storage cost trivial

rows.title: Depth source to unblock replacement-depth (Q05)
rows.description: Replacement depth (2nd/3rd/4th string) is blank because no depth source exists.
rows.option_a: License official snap counts as starter proxy (verified route per club).
rows.option_b: Use club depth pages where available, verified club-by-club.
rows.option_c: Leave depth blank and flagged; track designations only.
rows.recommended_path: A or B, but only after one route is verified for all 32 clubs (do not build the feature until verified).
rows.risk: deriving depth from jersey number/salary/experience is explicitly rejected

rows.title: Consolidate the overlapping NFL namespaces
rows.description: Fifteen NFL namespaces exist in this repo (nfl/, nfl-core/, nfl-market/, nfl-markets/, nfl-lines/, nfl-lab/, nfl-quant/, nfl-origination/, nfl-own/, nfl-book/, nfl-price-snapshot/, nfl-ledger/, nfl-command/, nfl-arena/, nfl-edge/, plus more), each re-implementing the same brief.
rows.option_a: Choose one canonical dashboard and retire the rest.
rows.option_b: Keep all namespaces as independent research workspaces, cross-linked.
rows.recommended_path: A — the owner picks one canonical workspace (compare page D-1 exists in nfl-core); do not add a sixteenth implementation.
rows.risk: fragmented navigation confuses reviewers; duplicate numbers can diverge

rows.title: Upgrade the fair-line model from v1 to v2
rows.description: The v1 model uses team strength from PF/PA, a +2.0 pt home-field assumption, an uncalibrated logistic, and a league-average total. All are flagged limitations.
rows.option_a: v2: team-strength-adjusted totals, calibrated win-probability, measured home-field advantage.
rows.option_b: Keep v1 as the published baseline and do not present it as an edge.
rows.option_c: Retire the model; publish only fair-line methodology without numbers.
rows.recommended_path: B — publish v1 honestly as a baseline, flagged; build v2 only after a price feed exists to calibrate against.
rows.risk: v2 without an executable price is still ungradeable (G7)

rows.title: Pre-register the demotion drawdown limit (DG-1c)
rows.description: DG-1c needs a pre-registered maximum drawdown before any strategy can go live.
rows.option_a: Set a fixed drawdown limit (e.g. -10% of bankroll) now.
rows.option_c: Do not set a limit; keep all strategies pre-registered/paper.
rows.recommended_path: C — no strategy is live, so no limit is needed yet; register one before the first LIVE promotion.
rows.risk: setting a limit without data is arbitrary

rows.title: Fund and govern the reward pool before paying points
rows.description: 0 of 1,000 reward points are paid because no strategy qualifies. Terms do not yet exist.
rows.option_a: Owner funds a pool and writes payout governance (skill-based, prospective, escrowed CLV/ROI).
rows.option_b: No rewards; leaderboard is reputational only.
rows.option_c: Token/points rewards with no monetary value.
rows.recommended_path: B or C until the owner decides; no reward is paid without written terms.
rows.risk: paying rewards for unvalidated results pays for luck, not skill

rows.title: Run the 32-team roster/IR sweep
rows.description: Before any team-level model is trusted, verify IR/reserve-list status for every club so 'not listed' never means 'available'.
rows.option_a: Capture official transactions/IR pages for all 32 teams.
rows.option_c: Use third-party roster data labeled as such.
rows.recommended_path: A — required by Q13 before team-level outputs are trusted.
rows.risk: IR capture must be official; third-party rosters are not evidence

rows.title: Model injury as a surprise (delta), never a level
rows.description: Policy decision recorded: designations enter the model as changes (Questionable→Out, DNP→LP→FP), never as a static level. Not yet implemented in code.
rows.option_a: Implement designation-delta features with unit tests.
rows.option_b: Keep the policy as documentation only.
rows.option_c: Do not use injury features at all.
rows.recommended_path: A — implement and test; do not ship a level-based injury feature.
rows.risk: delta features need the timestamped injury snapshots from S-02

rows.title: Archive historical weekly injury reports (for Q06)
rows.description: Q06 (do designations change outcomes?) requires multiple seasons of designations joined to inactives.
rows.option_a: Build an archive of past-season weekly injury reports.
rows.option_c: Use a single season as a pilot.
rows.recommended_path: C — pilot one season to test measurability before committing to a multi-season archive.
rows.risk: official injury reports for past seasons may not be retrievable

summary: 10 suggestions, all review_status = pending. None is implemented. The owner reviews and picks a path before anything new is built.
